entry.title: Utilities · Mon, Nov 2, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Western Virginia Water Authority Water Supply Study Results Briefing. City Council's informal session agenda scheduled a 30-minute briefing on the results of the Western Virginia Water Authority water supply study.
Proposed: Public Hearing Request for Roanoke Gas Company Utility Easement. The consent agenda recommended scheduling and advertising a public hearing for November 16, 2026, regarding a request from Roanoke Gas Company for a utility easement on city-owned property at 304 Reserve Avenue, SW.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6593,plainText=false)

entry.title: Utilities · Mon, Jul 6, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Water Matters to Roanoke Conservation Campaign. The City Manager announced the launch of the 'Water Matters to Roanoke' conservation campaign in coordination with the Western Virginia Water Authority to raise awareness about water resources and the Drought Contingency Plan.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6513,plainText=false)

entry.title: Utilities · Mon, Jun 15, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Water Authority Funds for Wasena Bridge Replacement. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating funds from the Western Virginia Water Authority for utility work associated with the Wasena Bridge Replacement project. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Discussion / report: Drought Conditions and Water Conservation Measures. Council members and the Mayor discussed potential messaging and triggers for voluntary versus mandatory water conservation measures in response to drought conditions, noting Western Virginia Water Authority's role.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6502,plainText=false)

entry.title: Utilities · Mon, May 18, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Capital Project Updates: Riverland Road/Star Trail and Westside Boulevard/Salem Turnpike. The City Manager presented infrastructure updates on the Riverland Road/Star Trail Connection Project, noting major drainage installations and a planned pedestrian link, as well as the Westside Boulevard/Salem Turnpike Pedestrian Improvements Project, which is progressing to curb, sidewalk, and pavement restoration.
Discussion / report: Public Information Updates on Recycling Delays and Northwest Economic Development. Staff provided follow-up details on public communications, including TV graphics addressing recycling pick-up delays, and summarized community engagement outreach regarding Northwest Roanoke economic development initiatives including the Main Street America program and Melrose Plaza.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6490,plainText=false)

entry.title: Utilities · Mon, May 11, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Adoption of Annual Budget Appropriations for FY 2026–2027. City Council adopted three ordinances making annual appropriations for the General, Stormwater Utility, Civic Facilities, Parking, Risk Management, School General, School Food Services, and Grant funds for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2026, and ending June 30, 2027. Ordinance Nos. 43387-051126 and 43388-051126 were adopted 5-2, with Vice-Mayor McGuire and Council Member Hagen voting no. Ordinance No. 43389-051126 was adopted 5-0, with Vice-Mayor McGuire and Council Member Sanchez-Jones abstaining.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6475,plainText=false)

entry.title: Utilities · Mon, Oct 5, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Stormwater Annual Compliance Report. The City Manager highlighted the completion of the City's annual stormwater compliance report, noting accomplishments such as 10 citywide street-sweeping cycles removing over 1,000 tons of sediment, storm drain cleanings, inspections of nearly 29,000 feet of pipe, and outreach to more than 38,000 residents.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6579,plainText=false)

entry.title: Utilities · Mon, Aug 17, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Drainage Easement at Virginia Heights Elementary School Property. Following a public hearing, City Council adopted an ordinance authorizing a drainage easement across City-owned property at 1210 Amherst Street, SW (Tax Map Number 1330301), also known as Virginia Heights Elementary School. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6543,plainText=false)

entry.title: Utilities · Mon, Sep 21, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Public Matters Follow-Up on Wilmont Park Area Curbing and Stormwater Runoff. Staff followed up on a resident's inquiry regarding curbing and stormwater runoff in the Wilmont Park area. Stormwater staff determined the runoff is caused by the private driveway's grade and that curb and gutter installation would only be aesthetic rather than solve the problem, offering the owner options for handling the driveway runoff.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6565,plainText=false)
